title: What dinosaur am I? Free dinosaur personality quiz — cv.cm
description: Free dinosaur quiz: answer 12 questions to find out if you're a T. rex, Triceratops, Velociraptor, Stegosaurus, Brachiosaurus, Ankylosaurus, Spinosaurus or Parasaurolophus, with real facts about yours. No sign-up.
lede: A bold T. rex, a quick and clever Velociraptor or a gentle giant like Brachiosaurus? Answer 12 questions to find the dinosaur that matches your personality, with a real fact about it.
about: Dinosaurs lived for more than 160 million years, and each one had its own way of surviving: Tyrannosaurus rex was one of the biggest land predators ever; Triceratops had three horns and a huge frill; Velociraptor was a feathered hunter about the size of a turkey; Stegosaurus had plates on its back and spikes on its tail; Brachiosaurus reached treetops with its long neck; Ankylosaurus was covered in armor and swung a bony tail club; Spinosaurus had a tall sail and caught fish; and Parasaurolophus had a hollow crest it probably used to make loud calls. This quiz matches your personality with one of these eight.

Your result names your dinosaur, explains what it says about you and shows your scores for all eight. The personalities are for fun, but the facts are real. Flying pterosaurs such as Pteranodon and sea reptiles such as Mosasaurus lived at the same time, but they weren't dinosaurs, so they're not in the quiz.

faq.a: Tyrannosaurus rex, Triceratops, Velociraptor, Stegosaurus, Brachiosaurus, Ankylosaurus, Spinosaurus and Parasaurolophus.

faq.q: Is one dinosaur rarer than the others?
faq.a: Every dinosaur appears in the same number of answers, so each one is equally likely.
No. Pterosaurs were flying reptiles, close cousins of dinosaurs but a separate group. Birds, on the other hand, are living dinosaurs.

faq.q: Is this a scientific personality test?
faq.a: No. It's a fun quiz written for cv.cm, and your answers stay in your browser.

trex.name: Tyrannosaurus rex
trex.body: You're bold, confident and a natural leader. When you walk in, people notice, and you're not afraid to go after what you want. Fun fact: T. rex had one of the strongest bites of any land animal ever. Your strength is real; use it to protect, not just to win.

triceratops.name: Triceratops
triceratops.body: You're loyal, protective and stubborn in the best way. You stand your ground and defend the people and ideas you believe in. Fun fact: Triceratops' frill and horns may have been for display as much as defense. You're as much about heart as armor.

velociraptor.name: Velociraptor
velociraptor.body: You're quick, clever and strategic. You think fast, act faster and work best with a small, trusted team. Fun fact: the real Velociraptor was about the size of a turkey and covered in feathers; the film raptors were based on a bigger relative. Like it, you're more than people expect.

stegosaurus.name: Stegosaurus
stegosaurus.body: You're calm, steady and quietly strong. You like your routines, you don't rush and you set clear boundaries when you need to. Fun fact: Stegosaurus lived so long before T. rex that less time separates us from T. rex than T. rex from it. You're timeless.

brachiosaurus.name: Brachiosaurus
brachiosaurus.body: You're a gentle giant: kind, calm and easy to be around. You see the big picture and you rarely lose your cool. Fun fact: Brachiosaurus could reach leaves more than 9 meters up. Keep your head high, and remember to stand up for yourself when needed.

ankylosaurus.name: Ankylosaurus
ankylosaurus.body: You're tough, resilient and self-protective. Criticism bounces off you and you can weather almost anything. Fun fact: Ankylosaurus was covered in bony plates and swung a heavy tail club. Behind your armor is a loyal friend; let people in a little sooner.

spinosaurus.name: Spinosaurus
spinosaurus.body: You're unique, adaptable and a bit of a mystery. You don't follow the herd and you're comfortable where others aren't. Fun fact: Spinosaurus had a tall sail on its back and spent much of its time in or near water, catching fish. Being different is your superpower.

parasaurolophus.name: Parasaurolophus
parasaurolophus.body: You're social, expressive and the one who keeps the group talking. You love music, conversation and your crew. Fun fact: Parasaurolophus' long, hollow crest probably worked like a trumpet for deep calls. Your voice brings people together.
